title: Community showcase links got a cleanup
summary:
A spring-cleaning day for the community project showcase: fewer dead links and tidier project tables.

Dead project links were removed, and some entries now point to working demos or repositories. The cleanup covered projects across chat, creative, games, learning, and other categories.

The toai.chat listing no longer includes an invalid website URL; its description, author credit, and repository link remain.

The README and PROJECTS.md tables were updated after the listing cleanup, with a note that external project links may become unavailable. The table generator’s import was also fixed.
